name: Kaboom
description: Teams draw sticks from the cup – but whoever draws KABOOM loses everything.
intro: Take turns drawing a stick from the cup. Translated correctly? Then you may keep it. But watch out: whoever draws KABOOM has to put all their sticks back!
teamDraws: {name}, it's your turn – draw a stick!

teamLost: {name} has to put back {n} stick. | {name} has to put back {n} sticks.
teamLucky: Lucky – {name} didn't have any sticks yet.

room.intro: Kaboom for 2–6 players, each on their own device. Take turns drawing sticks – but whoever draws KABOOM loses them all!
room.yourDraw: It's your turn – draw a stick!
